title: Cyrus of Xerxes line
summary: Raleigh names Cyrus of Xerxes line in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Cyrus, named between Cambyses and Teispeus in the line by which Xerxes deriueth himselfe. He is not Cyrus the Great, and not Cyrus the first of that name in Reineccius his first race. The one-word title would fold onto the Cyrus already titled in one word, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
